acer - chromebook plus spin 514 2-in-1 f.description: Acer Chromebook Plus Spin 514 2-in-1 Laptop: The Acer Chromebook Plus Spin 514 is a versatile 2-in-1 laptop engineered for everyday productivity and flexibility. Powered by an Intel Core i5-1334U processor (up to 4.6GHz, 10 cores), 8GB DDR5 RAM, and a 512GB PCIe NVMe SSD, it delivers swift multitasking and ample storage for demanding tasks. Features: 14" WUXGA (1920 x 1200) IPS LED-backlit touchscreen with Intel UHD graphics for vivid, crisp visuals; FHD Facial Auto Exposure Camera with privacy shutter for secure, clear video calls; Integrated Google AI Gemini and Google One AI Premium Plan for advanced productivity tools and 2TB cloud storage; Up to 10-hour battery life for all-day use; Versatile connectivity: 2 x USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 2, USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A, HDMI 1.4, Wi-Fi 6E, Bluetooth 5.2, and backlit keyboard; Supports up to 3 external 4K monitors via HDMI and Type-C. Manufacturer: Acer America. Operating System: Chrome OS (AUE Date: June 2032) Ideal for students and professionals, this Chromebook offers security, speed, and adaptability for modern computing needs.
